why: Owner steer 2026-09-16: the Lilmoth road approaches the city from the north-west, not looping round to enter from the east; an approach pin, so the last leg is a straight corridor into the anchor (round 3: the pin alone was honoured and the road still looped east).
Owner steer 2026-09-16: the same road stays at the foot of the north-western mountains on its way up to Stormhold.
Owner steer 2026-09-16: the Stormhold road out of Gideon follows the firm lowland at the base of the western mountains instead of entering the heartland.

Owner steer 2026-09-16 (round 3): the Stormhold road leaves Gideon north-east across the firm lowland, fords the small stream (reach.949-1591, 11 m wide, 1.2 m deep) near 1.77 E 2.92 S and carries on north, instead of running east with the Archon road to 2.5 E 3.1 S and curving back.

Owner steer 2026-09-16: both roads reach Soulrest from the north; an approach pin, so the last leg is a straight corridor into the anchor (round 3: the pin alone was honoured and the road still looped west).
Owner steer 2026-09-16 (round 3): the road reaches the east coast strip on dry ground and turns north for Thorn.

Owner steer 2026-09-16 (round 3): east of the crossing the road takes the dry strip at the mountain foot and crosses the inlet stream at its mouth on a short boardwalk, instead of the long swing south through the coastal swamp.
Owner steer 2026-09-16 (round 3): the flat at the foot of the eastern mountains, above the coastal marsh.

Owner steer 2026-09-16 (round 3): the one crossing of river.889-484, from the south-west bank to the north-east bank where the river bends south at the mountain foot; the road then carries on east to Thorn.
Owner steer 2026-09-16 (round 3): the road hugs the flat dry land on the south-west side of river.889-484, close to the river and the marsh it crosses. It does not veer south into the Hist heartland.
Owner steer 2026-09-16 (round 3): still on the south-west bank, on the flat below the terraced hills.

Owner steer 2026-09-16 (round 3): the Thorn road leaves Stormhold along the dry ground SOUTH of the river and of the lake the river runs past east of the city, never north of the river (the north bank was walked and is too steep).
Owner steer 2026-09-16 (round 3): up the east coast strip, so the last kilometre into Thorn is on the dry shore and never in the perennial swamp.
